purpose: Written BEFORE any results exist, so the bar cannot be moved after seeing them. Edit it NOW if you disagree, then leave it alone. evaluate.py stores a fingerprint of this file the first time it runs and warns loudly if the file changes later.

how_to_read_the_verdict.KEEP RUNNING: Not enough trades or days yet. This is NOT a failure. Change nothing and keep collecting results.
how_to_read_the_verdict.FAILED: Enough data and at least one bar missed. Do not go near real money. Study the journal; any rule change restarts the clock with a new frozen criteria file.
how_to_read_the_verdict.MET: Every bar cleared on enough data. That earns a discussion about a very small real-money trial, with a tight loss limit and manual approval at first. It proves nothing about the future.
